title: E-Commerce Platform - Service Health
description: Starter dashboard for the User/Catalog/Order/Payment services. Import via SigNoz UI: Dashboards -> New Dashboard -> Import JSON. Panel queries use the OTLP metrics the opentelemetry-javaagent + Micrometer emit (http.server.duration and the actuator-derived http_server_requests_seconds series) - adjust metric/attribute names if they differ on your collector build.

service_name.description: Filter every panel to one service

widgets.title: Request Latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
widgets.description: Server-side request duration percentiles, per service.

widgets.title: Throughput (requests / sec)
widgets.description: Inbound request rate per service and route.

widgets.title: Error Rate (%)
widgets.description: Share of requests with a 5xx (or exception) status, per service.

widgets.title: Service Health / Uptime
widgets.description: Actuator liveness state per service, backed by k8s probe results or the /actuator/health endpoint scraped into SigNoz.

widgets.title: Downstream Call Latency (Order -> User / Catalog / Payment)
widgets.description: Client-span duration for orderservice's outbound calls - the panel that shows which downstream dependency is dragging down checkout latency.

widgets.title: JVM Heap Usage
widgets.description: Runtime metrics captured automatically by the java agent, per service.
